title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: Y. whereas the Baltic Sea harbour porpoise is facing extinction and only a few hundred of these mammals are left in the Baltic Proper19; whereas this species is under continued threat from being caught as ‘bycatch’, from environmental contaminants, prey depletion and disturbance from underwater noise, including impulsive noise generated during the construction of offshore wind farms, which, according to the ICES workshop on the impacts of offshore renewable energy on fisheries and marine ecosystems, has the potential to cause irreversible damage to this critically endangered population and could contribute to its extinction; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 19 https://helcom.fi/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Red-List-II-species-2025.pdf.
